title: The Terminal of the Rust Belt
author: Ansel Brightwater
blurb: Edmund Dravenmoor, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
